findings.title: Shape-invalid upgrade_reasons values can bypass the required hard-error path
findings.description: The fragment contract requires upgrade_reasons to be an optional array of tokens and AC-027 requires every supplied shape-invalid fragment to exit 2 without trigger reporting. Both implementations deliberately apply falsiness before checking the array type: Python uses entry.get("upgrade_reasons") or [], while PowerShell uses Test-PythonFalsy. Consequently false, 0, "", and null are accepted as an absent/empty array. Moreover, upgrade_reasons is validated only for eligible:false entries, so an eligible:true entry with any malformed upgrade_reasons value is accepted and can yield lite-eligible/exit 0. This violates the fail-closed security boundary and the documented exact fragment shape. The tests cover a truthy scalar but omit these falsy scalars and malformed fields on eligible:true entries.

findings.title: Required verification checks are explicitly failing
findings.description: T-002.contract.json records the required regression and placeholder-scan checks with passes:false. Its own comment says full-repository regression still fails and the placeholder scan exits 1 without the required human acceptance in a quality-gate report. A PASS cannot be supported while mandatory checks remain red.

findings.title: Verification contract is bound to a stale specification revision
findings.description: The contract pins spec_revision 2740928c9e9c45cd56644a0e22e4fb5fc3c270932eba9c8fecf4a8450780d437, while its own disclosure states the current specification digest is 466465e04248cb912635ed83435ff0c17e9805648e0caead7132ad6276a34d23 and that no independent gate has re-issued the contract. Thus the evidence does not verify the specification revision contained in this bundle.

findings.title: Required protected-file publication and independent security verification remain incomplete
findings.description: The task's Done When requires a human to apply the staged protected-file payload through the anchored runner and verify installed hashes. The implementation report explicitly says this step remains pending and that no dedicated independent security review of T-002's staged security-sensitive scripts has been recorded. The live protected implementation therefore has not been demonstrated to contain the reviewed payload.
